stem.text: Whooping cough is a highly infectious disease of the gas exchange system, caused by the bacterium *Bordetella pertussis*.
Which method provides protection to infants against whooping cough and reduces the chance of developing this disease later?

A.text: a short course of more than one type of antibiotic

B.text: a six-month course of one type of antibiotic

C.text: injections of antibodies specific to *Bordetella pertussis*

D.text: injections of antigens from *Bordetella pertussis* bacteria
